This Miscellaneous First Appeal Is Filed Under Section 173 (1)
Of M.V. Act Praying To Allow The Appeal By Modifying The Judgment
AND AWARD DATED 05.04.2019 PASSED BY THE II ADDL. DIST.

AND SESSIONS JUDGE AND MACT, RAICHUR IN MVC.NO.291/2017 AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION FROM RS.10,82,000/- TO RS.31,00,000/- WITH INTEREST @ 12 PERCENT PER ANNUM FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL ACTUAL REALIZATION, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the appellant / claimant has filed a memo seeking permission to withdraw the appeal.
02. Memo is taken on record.
03. In view of the memo, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
04. The amount if any deposited before this Court shall be transferred to the Tribunal forthwith.
